SELECT
  b."BATCH_ID",
  CURRENT_UTCTIMESTAMP () AS "LOAD_TIMESTAMP",
  'S4_CURR' AS "SOURCE_SYSTEM",
  o."SOURCE_FILE",
  "d"."PurchaseOrder","d"."PurchaseOrderItem","d"."AccountAssignmentNumber","d"."CostCenter","d"."MasterFixedAsset","d"."ProjectNetwork","d"."Quantity","d"."PurchaseOrderQuantityUnit","d"."MultipleAcctAssgmtDistrPercent","d"."PurgDocNetAmount","d"."DocumentCurrency","d"."IsDeleted","d"."GLAccount","d"."BusinessArea","d"."SalesOrder","d"."SalesOrderItem","d"."SalesOrderScheduleLine","d"."FixedAsset","d"."OrderID","d"."UnloadingPointName","d"."ControllingArea","d"."CostObject","d"."ProfitabilitySegment","d"."ProfitabilitySegment_2","d"."ProfitCenter","d"."WBSElementInternalID","d"."ProjectNetworkInternalID","d"."CommitmentItem","d"."CommitmentItemShortID","d"."FundsCenter","d"."Fund","d"."FunctionalArea","d"."GoodsRecipientName","d"."IsFinallyInvoiced","d"."RealEstateObject","d"."NetworkActivityInternalID","d"."PartnerAccountNumber","d"."JointVentureRecoveryCode","d"."SettlementReferenceDate","d"."OrderInternalID","d"."OrderIntBillOfOperationsItem","d"."TaxCode","d"."TaxJurisdiction","d"."NonDeductibleInputTaxAmount","d"."CostCtrActivityType","d"."BusinessProcess","d"."GrantID","d"."BudgetPeriod","d"."EarmarkedFundsDocument","d"."EarmarkedFundsDocumentItem","d"."ServiceDocumentType","d"."ServiceDocument","d"."ServiceDocumentItem","d"."PurchaseOrderType","d"."PurchasingOrganization","d"."PurchasingGroup","d"."CreationDate","d"."LastChangeDateTime","d"."Plant","d"."AccountAssignmentCategory","d"."CompanyCode","d"."IsReturnsItem","d"."SupplyingPlant","d"."PurchaseOrderItemCategory","d"."Material","d"."MaterialGroup","d"."PurchaseOrderDate","d"."StorageLocation","d"."IsCompletelyDelivered","d"."PurchasingInfoRecord","d"."RequirementTracking","d"."PurchaseOrderItemText","d"."PurgDocumentItemDeletionCode","d"."PurchasingDocumentDeletionCode","d"."InvoiceIsExpected","d"."GoodsReceiptIsExpected","d"."ProductTypeCode","d"."IsStatisticalItem","d"."ReleaseIsNotCompleted","d"."PurchasingCompletenessStatus","d"."PurchaseContract","d"."PurchaseContractItem","d"."Change_Type","d"."Change_Date"
FROM
  "1_INBOUND_S4_CURR.1LT_C_PURORDACCOUNTASSIGNMENTDEX_S4_CURR_Delta" d
  CROSS JOIN "2SV_ACTIVE_BATCH_S4_CURR_01" b
  JOIN "2LT_CTRL_LOAD_OBJECT_01" o ON o."BATCH_ID" = b."BATCH_ID"
  AND o."SOURCE_SYSTEM" = 'S4_CURR'
  AND o."OBJECT_NAME" = 'C_PURORDACCOUNTASSIGNMENTDEX'
